entities.summary: The Fatih Mosque, also known alternately as Xhamia e vogël and Xhamia e vjetër, is a mosque, located in Durrës, Albania. Completed in 1502 CE, the year after the Turkish conquest of the city, the mosque was designated as a Cultural Monument of Albania in 1973.
